subject: Production: Elevated 5xx/429 and timeouts after model-v9 rollout
messages:
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@brightlinehealth.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Emma Ruiz <emma.ruiz@brightlinehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Production errors after model-v9 rollout - urgent

Team,

We pushed your model-v9 for our conversational triage flows at 07:45 PT and immediately saw a spike in 429/5xx responses and user-facing timeouts. Impact: ~18% of clinical sessions experienced an interruption (timeouts at p95 ~2.8s -> 9.2s), and our frontend started returning retry storms that cascaded into 5xx spikes.

Attached are a compressed sample of the most recent request/response traces and a handful of app logs (brightline_prod_sample_logs_0712.txt). We cannot keep this in production — clinicians are being dropped mid-session.

As a paying customer with an upcoming launch, we need an urgent mitigation and an ETA for resolution. Options we discussed during the runbook call: immediate rollback to model-v8, enable per-tenant rate limiting, or a fallback to a smaller model for critical routes. Please advise next steps and expected timeline.

Sanjay
Sanjay Patel
Head of Platform Operations, Brightline Health
(sanjay.patel@brightlinehealth.com)

Thanks Sanjay — we see the same telemetry from our side. I’m escalating to infra and product immediately.

Immediate plan (short):
- Open incident & PagerDuty alert (PD-123456) — on-call engaged.
- Halt further rollouts for affected clusters.
- Prepare an expedited rollback to model-v8 scoped to Brightline if we cannot mitigate in 30–45 minutes.

@Michael, can you confirm whether this looks like a kernel/quantization execution issue vs. a routing/traffic shape problem? Any fast mitigations we can apply without a full rollback?
@Marissa / @Lauren, I’ll coordinate comms and the mutual action plan with Brightline leadership — please prep the customer-facing RCA and remediation options.

I’ll stand up a 15-minute bridge if helpful.

Sean Gallagher

From: michael_grant@redwood.ai
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@brightlinehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 08:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production errors after model-v9 rollout - urgent

On Sun, Jul 12, 2026 at 08:12 AM Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@brightlinehealth.com> wrote:
> We pushed your model-v9 for our conversational triage flows at 07:45 PT and immediately saw a spike in 429/5xx responses and user-facing timeouts.

I pulled the host and runtime traces for Brightline's cluster. Short summary:
- Root cause hypothesis: a quantization/kernel selection mismatch for the new model-v9 build on our CUDA12/driver combo resulted in a ~3–3.5x increase in per-token compute for long-context requests.
- Evidence: increased CPU-side waiting on GPU warmup, KV cache eviction counts jump, and a handful of CUDA ATOMIC stalls correlating with the timestamp you provided.
- Observed effect: requests that previously finished <1s are now often timing out or being retried by the client, triggering a feedback loop.

Quick mitigations we can apply immediately (low risk):
1) Pin Brightline traffic to the pre-rollout kernel/quant profile for the next 30–60m (non-disruptive routing change).
2) Deploy a per-tenant concurrency cap on high-latency routes to limit retries.
3) Short-term autoscale: bump dedicated pool capacity for Brightline while we investigate (costly but buys time).

If those don’t stop the 5xx/429 surge within 30 minutes, I recommend a scoped rollback to model-v8 for Brightline only. I’ve attached a 200-line excerpt of the hottest runtime trace (brightline_prod_sample_logs_0712.txt).

I’ll start preparing a rollback playbook and will post the exact commands on the bridge.

—Michael Grant
Senior Infra Engineer, Serving Runtime — Redwood Inference
michael_grant@redwood.ai

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@brightlinehealth.com>, sean_gallagher@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 08:55:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production errors after model-v9 rollout - urgent

Sanjay — thanks for flagging and for the logs. We’re treating this as a P1.

Customer-facing options we’re executing now:
- Option A: Kernel/quant pinning (Michael to implement) — aim to remove the compute regression quickly while keeping v9 live.
- Option B: If pinning fails, scoped rollback to model-v8 for Brightline (no tenant-wide rollback).
- Option C: Temporary per-route fallback to a smaller model for the next 72 hours while we stabilize and analyze.

I’ve attached a short Mutual Action Plan with timelines and the commitment to deliver an internal RCA within 72 hours (mutual-action-plan-Brightline.pdf). If we end up doing a rollback, we will offer a service credit for the affected window and a joint postmortem within 5 business days.

We’ll propose a 30-minute bridge at 09:00 PT to run through the chosen mitigation, confirm the rollback window, and align exec comms. Can your execs join that call?

—Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Reliability — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Sanjay
